## Problem

Identify the file, schema version and requirement. Describe the inconsistency
or unclear behavior, with a small original synthetic example if helpful.

## Expected result

Describe the intended requirement or clarification and why it matters.
Separate a schema constraint from a semantic check a future consumer must make.

## Evidence

Include reproduction steps and local check results where relevant. State which
checks were not run. Do not attach secrets, private histories or production logs.

## Possible contract effects

Would a change affect versions, extensions, examples or compatibility? Link an
existing local ADR or proposal if relevant; a solution is not required to report
a problem.
